scope: Eight November 22 paper tracks. Source-byte custody and declared theorem-name evidence only; no source-to-headline semantic equivalence, new Lean replay, independent adjudication or novelty claim.

policy.promotion: Metadata validation never promotes a mathematical theorem. A theorem requires a same-pin kernel replay of its entire relevant closure, frozen exact-type and transitive definitions, independent model audit, dated prior art and owner authorization.
policy.trust_boundary: Ledger and workflow changes require owner-controlled branch protection; candidate-side JSON/CI cannot attest its own authority.
policy.review: Constructor, independent reproducer and adversarial auditor must use separate implementations and predeclared scopes; labels alone confer no independence.
policy.resource: Cost contracts and oracle semantics must match exactly; a finite tree expectation does not certify full quantum query complexity.

records.title: Quadratic variance–influence on arbitrary product spaces
records.claim_scope: Degree-two variance/influence inequality across arbitrary independent product sources; distinguish finite heterogeneous alphabets and actual infinite-index measurable models.
records.gap: The cited native heterogeneous Q2 terminal is finite-index; no implied all-measurable-product or unrestricted L² theorem.

records.title: All-degree product-space influence
records.claim_scope: Aaronson–Ambainis degree-d influence on independent product laws, with arbitrary-index/coordinate assumptions distinguished from finite reductions and external imported results.
records.gap: Check exact Lp/measurability premises, transitive imports and AA/Turturean prior art; source anchoring is not semantic closure.

records.title: Route 1 / Wyner-information quantum-query simulation
records.claim_scope: Bounded-degree simulation on latent mixtures of independent product laws; separate product-mixture theorem from unrestricted correlated-oracle, physical quantum, and quadratic Wyner extensions.
records.gap: Physical oracle semantics, query locality, source/degree transfer and general quadratic-Wyner claims remain separate gates.

records.title: Rank-sensitive Hilbert observability
records.claim_scope: Rank-sensitive Hilbert-valued adaptive observability and source-to-query budget theorem for arbitrary independent products.
records.gap: Finite-index algebra assumes source budgets; actual posterior ANOVA section-to-budget and adaptive query deduction are not supplied by this declaration.

records.title: Task-revelation information-cover law
records.claim_scope: Task-dependent information-cover with adaptive posterior, KL/Bayes-risk and sequential query cost, for the specified observation oracle.
records.gap: LP weak duality alone does not certify stochastic KL chain rule, Bayes risk, adaptive sequential cost or unrestricted task-revelation theorem.

records.title: Sharp continuous-causal real phase retrieval
records.claim_scope: Continuous causal squared-linear observations on reachable histories, all real signals up to global sign; distinguish fixed-prefix obstruction and unrestricted causal lower bound.
records.gap: The source excludes coordinate-first plus one continuous final row; unconditional product-sphere zero theorem and general causal transcript threshold are not established by it.

records.title: Sharp tensor-subcube intersection exponent log₂(3)
records.claim_scope: All tensor levels and linear subspaces with row intersection upper bound and full-space 3^L sharpness extremizer; separate affine/quantum simulation extensions.
records.gap: Sharp linear-subspace row count does not itself prove a rank-free two-query quantum simulation theorem.

records.title: Optimal physical quantum POVM
records.claim_scope: POVM discrimination/Bayes-gain optimum under explicit complex positive-semidefinite effects, measurement normalization and specified tensor model.
records.gap: Check positivity/normalization hypotheses, physical implementability, tensor product scaling and distinct imported measurement lemmas.
